finding.before: Typed responsive Inspector controls exposed data-property-id but not their registry command or Page Model key; state preview reused those controls while dispatching states.set.
finding.impact: A DOM/source audit could identify the property but could not verify which command/key the rendered control actually used.
finding.scope: Shared typed property controls and hover/focus state controls; no value semantics or save behavior changed.

implementation.typed_controls: Expose data-property-id, data-property-command and data-property-key from the registry property.
implementation.state_controls: Pass the actual states.set route explicitly while retaining the registry property key.
implementation.cache_bust: 20261026-inspector-command-key-contract on the app entry and property-controls import.

routes_asserted: hover background color and gradient → states.set / registered keys
